record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: Find an integrable deformation of the N = 1 supersymmetric KdV equation whose deformation mechanism reproduces the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws that arise for the super KdV system.

evidence.quote: OP-1: Find an integrable deformation that reproduces the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the N=1 supersymmetric Korteweg–de Vries (sKdV) equation, written in an N=1 superspace with even coordinate x, odd coordinate θ, and even time t. Let Φ(x,θ,t) = ξ(x,t) + θ u(x,t) be a fermionic superfield, where u is bosonic and ξ is fermionic, and let D = ∂_θ + θ ∂_x be the odd superderivative (so D² = ∂_x). The sKdV equation is

    Φ_t = -Φ_{xxx} + 3 (Φ D Φ)_x ,

which in components reads
    u_t = -u_{xxx} + 6 u u_x - 3 ξ ξ_{xx},
    ξ_t = -ξ_{xxx} + 3 (u ξ)_x .

This system admits, in addition to its infinite tower of local bosonic conservation laws, an infinite sequence of fermionic nonlocal conservation laws (whose densities involve formal antiderivatives of polynomial differential expressions in u, ξ, and their derivatives).

Problem. Construct an integrable one-parameter deformation of the N=1 sKdV equation — that is, a family of evolutionary super-PDEs depending on a continuous parameter ε which reduces to the sKdV equation at ε = 0, possesses a Lax representation (or, equivalently, a bi-Hamiltonian structure / infinite hierarchy of commuting symmetries) for every ε, and is such that the deformation mechanism systematically generates / reproduces the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws of the undeformed sKdV system (for instance, in the spirit of a Gardner-type deformation in which expanding the deformed conserved densities in powers of ε yields the nonlocal fermionic charges of sKdV). Alternatively, prove that no such integrable deformation exists.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of finding an integrable (Gardner-type) deformation of the N=1 super-KdV equation that reproduces its fermionic nonlocal conservation laws appears to remain open. Related work (Andrea/Kersten/Krasil'shchik on nonlocal conservation laws and recursion structures, Kiselev and others on nonlocal Gardner-type deformations of super-KdV) has produced partial constructions and nonlocal symmetry/deformation frameworks, but no complete integrable deformation realizing the full mechanism for the fermionic nonlocal charges has been reported. No definitive resolution was found in the literature search.

status_evidence.title: Non-local Conservation Laws and Flow Equations for Supersymmetric Integrable Hierarchies
status_evidence.snippet: Nonlocal conservation laws of N=1 super-KdV related to powers of the fourth root of its Lax operator; fermionic and bosonic nonlocal symmetries constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Existing work develops the nonlocal fermionic conservation law structure but does not provide a full integrable deformation realizing the deformation mechanism.

status_evidence.title: Bosonization, Singularity Analysis, Nonlocal Symmetry Reductions and Exact Solutions of Supersymmetric KdV Equation
status_evidence.snippet: Studies nonlocal symmetries of sKdV via bosonization but does not provide an integrable deformation reproducing the fermionic nonlocal conservation laws.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent literature addresses nonlocal symmetries of sKdV but does not settle the deformation question.
